{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the distribution of customer_age
print(sales['customer_age'].value_counts().sort_index())

# Check how many rows have customer_age == -1
invalid_age_count = (sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f"Number of rows with customer_age == -1: {invalid_age_count}")

# Check if these rows are in the converted group
converted_with_invalid_age = sales[(sales['customer_age'] == -1) & (sales['converted'] == 1)]
print(f"Number of converted customers with age == -1: {len(converted_with_invalid_age)}")

# Look at the data for these invalid rows
print(converted_with_invalid_age[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'status', 'revenue', 'converted']])"}
